purpose: R5 reviewers request reuse of a selected path under changed writer behavior without retuning
selection_source: all79 configurations and all8 margins from frozen INTERLOCKED_TIGHT_BUDGET_RESULTS.json
selected_policies: reuse each selected phase path and selected fixed-maintenance load/flush mask exactly as saved; do not search again
controls: both free reader-end release; reuse the fixed comparator's selected free boundary-flush subset
admission: same original budget, source service contract, and same path bounds; no budget inflation
reporting: retain all executions, wins/ties/losses, deadline/validity assertions and full-sweep denominators; characterize timing regimes without claiming a prespecified favorable subgroup
scope: same synthetic architecture model, configuration-reuse sensitivity; not application diversity, not a new globally optimal fixed comparator at each held-out writer gap
